description: Does this Reddit ad account qualify for Target Cost (bidStrategy TARGET_CPX)? Reddit retires Cost Cap (MAXIMIZE_VOLUME) on SALES, CONVERSIONS, LEAD_GENERATION, APP_INSTALLS and CATALOG_SALES on 2027-02-10; Target Cost replaces it where eligible, otherwise use BIDLESS. Pass the planned objective for a specific answer. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

objective.description: the campaign objective to check for, e.g. SALES

name: check_reddit_ads_target_cost_eligibility
title: Check Reddit Target Cost eligibility
